infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Clique uses the camera so you can take a memory for your group.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Clique uses your photos so you can pick a profile picture and share memories.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Clique uses the microphone when you record a video memory.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Clique saves memories you choose to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Clique reads your calendar to mark when you are busy. Event names never leave your phone.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Clique reads your calendar to mark when you are busy. Event names never leave your phone.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Clique counts your steps for the daily streak. The count stays on your phone.
